initial_model: Statewide adequacy and expansion sensitivities use an aggregate Kerala planning boundary; this is complemented by a separate public multi-bus chronological network screen.
next_model: Planning-grade spatial transmission expansion remains gated on future corridor capacities, upgrade options and costs, calibrated demand/generation geography, and stronger electrical validation.
atlas_status: Resource, ecology and network layers support screening and provenance; they are not a complete legal siting or planning-grade asset model.
coverage_rule: Statewide scope does not imply measured continuous interval telemetry, calibrated AC/N-1 security, complete ecological permitting constraints, or a validated investment plan.
